column1: # at the oracle frames that compare.py --align counter pairs with the port frames listed: where the
# game counts passes (lag is a number), the oracle frame whose count is the port's less the lag; in
# a clock stretch (port frames 313-1108, lag -), the one that shows the port frame's
# pictures. The SHA-1 of each screen's RGB bytes, or 3d for a screen that shows 3D, which only the
# oracle comparison can judge (known for a top screen left out), GFL's frame count there, and the
# SHA-1 of the game's state (NNS_G3dGlb) where the sequence compares
# it (- elsewhere). Hashes only. Written by oracle.py
# sequence aspertia --update; checked by oracle.py sequence-check aspertia.
# Left out, port frames 2878: the title hides its layers partway through the DS's frame; on the port, from the frame's first line
# Left out, port frames 3001: START brings the layers back partway through the DS's frame; on the port, from the frame's first line
# Left out, port frames 3101: START whitens the screens partway through the second frame of the DS's pass, which took two; on the port, from the first line of the pass's frame
# Left out, port frames 3112-3129: the DS's pass at START took two frames, so its camera, stepped by VBlanks, leads Kyurem's animation a step

# Left out, port frames 7751: after the intro the display turns off late in the DS's pass of some 30 frames (count 7750 in Black 2, 7810 in White 2), partway through a frame (black above line 115 in Black 2's last, above line 189 in White 2's second-last, whose last is white); on the port, from the first line of the pass's frame

# Left out, port frames 12911-12914,13727-13730,13967-13970,14223-14226: Mom's speech balloon, at the top of the screen (lines 4-44), scrolls a line up 4 pixels a pass (PrintStream_Task, src/system/printsys.c), and the DS's CPU takes milliseconds to copy the window's bitmap before it flushes it to VRAM, after the beam has drawn the window: the DS shows each step a frame later than the port, whose passes take no time (its window then equal to the port's frame before, pixel for pixel); the letters printed into it, with no copy, and the townsperson's window at the bottom of the screen show on the same count on both

# Left out, port frames 15176-15229: the zoom into the house, a scale of BG 2 that a VBlank callback steps at every VBlank (src/ov012/building_enter_effect.c), while the DS spends some 45 VBlanks more than passes loading the house (counts 15160-15190), so its zoom is further on at each count and it shows steps no port frame shows; the crossfade over it ends on the same count on both

# Top screen left out, port frames 4648-5040: Minccino's idle animation on the top screen, about 290 frames long, which it plays after a random wait of 200 to 280 passes in steps of 20 (GFL_RandomMTRange, IntroMcss_Update in src/ov294/intro_mcss.c): GFL's random numbers are seeded differently on the port (port/docs/decomp-findings.md, buildSeed), so the waits differ by construction. The port starts the idle at port frame 4668 in both versions; White 2's DS draws a wait three steps longer and starts it 60 passes later, so the port's wait is one of the two shortest, and with any draw on either program an idle starts from port frame 4648 to 4748 and ends by Minccino's fade-out (5038-5040), whose pose follows it. Black 2's DS draws the port's wait, one chance in five, so its frames match, but they are left out alike, since another seed would move them. The bottom screen is compared
